# contracts — committed event-taxonomy expectations (generated by sdv-py)

One `{feed}.contract.json` per feed: the OBSERVED event-type domain from the
committed real captures, frozen as a `modeling.integrity.DataContract`
(generated artifacts, like `sim_rendered/`). Generator:
`tools/taxonomy_contracts/build.py`; regenerate with
`uv run python -m tools.taxonomy_contracts.build`.

Feeds: v3 actionTypes (nba+nbagl pbp), ESPN basketball play types
(mbb/wbb/wnba summaries), ESPN football play types (nfl/cfb drives), NHL
typeDescKeys (api-web pbp), MLB result events (statsapi pbp), ESPN
scoreboard states (8 leagues' scoreboards + the documented pre/in
lifecycle states).

Gates (`tests/modeling/test_taxonomy_contracts.py`): offline, every
contract must exactly match the domain rebuilt from the fixtures — a
re-captured fixture with an unseen type goes red until the contracts are
deliberately regenerated; live (gated), the in-season feeds validate
against the same domains so new types surface via the weekly cron's
`live-tests:drift` issue flow instead of becoming silent parser gaps.
